# RFMix

## Role

RFMix is a command-line local-ancestry inference program. It assigns ancestry
along phased query haplotypes by using defined reference-panel populations.

## Inputs

- Phased query VCF/haplotypes.
- Phased reference-panel VCF/haplotypes with population labels.
- A genetic map and consistent reference build/chromosome naming.
- A sample manifest distinguishing reference and query individuals.

## Outputs to Retain

- Local-ancestry calls and posterior/probability outputs where available.
- Input and reference-panel manifests, maps, version, command, and logs.
- Per-sample ancestry summaries and QC against known truth in simulations.

## License Boundary

The RFMix v2 repository states that it is free for academic research use and
requires separate licensing for commercial use. simitall should link to its
official instructions rather than redistribute it.

## Reference

- Maples et al. (2013): DOI 10.1016/j.ajhg.2013.06.020.
- Official repository: https://github.com/slowkoni/rfmix
